page.overview:
Who is Earth Daimyō?

He is the former daimyō of the Land of Earth.

He appears to have an impatient attitude, as seen when he and the other daimyō awaited the response of the uncertain Water Daimyō. He prompted him to respond quickly due to the urgency of the impending war.

He has a very prominent, grey beard and moustache and his eyes have dark marks underneath them, giving him somewhat a similar appearance to the Tsuchikage. His face is further accentuated with creases running from his eyes. He wears the standard attire of the daimyō.

Upon the meeting of the daimyō of the Five Great Shinobi Countries, he questions the loyalty of the Water Daimyō towards his hidden village, due to his slow approval to the Shinobi Alliance. Before he could continue his lecture with the Water Daimyō, he is interrupted by Tenga, informing the daimyō that their long-distant calling is consuming much battery power. In result of the meeting, he concurs with the Lightning Daimyō on the creation of the alliance without any apparent hesitation.
